means: The whole subject plus a large amount of the place they are standing in. The figure is small; the location is the other half of the picture.
does: Shrinks the figure and hands the frame to the background. It also throws the face away: at wide size the head is a few dozen pixels, so eye colour, scar, ear stud and expression stop being drawable and character identity drops out of the shot. In the shot_size sweep the wide panel is a small silhouette on an empty pitch under a huge sky, and extreme_wide has no readable person in it at all.
reach_for_it: when the shot is about WHERE rather than WHO - once per scene to plant a location. Never for a line of dialogue, and never for a shot that has to carry a character's face.
used_in: the establish clause of shot.purpose ("wide shot, scenery, full body, distant subject") and the opening shot of most films in the library - films/chrono.json, films/hollow-choir.json, films/puddle.json, films/the-last-signal.json
